description: The directed, self-propelled movement of a cilium. [GOC:dph, GOC:jl]
label: CILIUM MOVEMENT *

description: The assembly and organization of an axoneme, the bundle of microtubules and associated proteins that forms the core of cilia (also called flagella) in eukaryotic cells and is responsible for their movements. [GOC:bf, GOC:cilia, GOC:jl, ISBN:0815316194]
label: AXONEME ASSEMBLY *

description: A process that results in a parallel arrangement of microtubules. [GOC:dph]
label: MICROTUBULE BUNDLE FORMATION *

description: Cell motility due to movement of eukaryotic cilia or bacterial-type flagella or archaeal-type flagella. [GOC:cilia, GOC:hjd, GOC:krc]
label: CILIUM OR FLAGELLUM DEPENDENT CELL MOTILITY *

description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a cilium, a specialized eukaryotic organelle that consists of a filiform extrusion of the cell surface. Each cilium is bounded by an extrusion of the cytoplasmic membrane, and contains a regular longitudinal array of microtubules, anchored basally in a centriole. [GOC:cilia, GOC:jl]
label: CILIUM ORGANIZATION *

description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a motile cilium. [GO_REF:0000079, GOC:cilia, GOC:krc, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:19776033, PMID:21129373, ZFIN:dsf]
label: MOTILE CILIUM ASSEMBLY *

description: A microtubule-based process that results in the movement of organelles, other microtubules, or other cellular components. Examples include motor-driven movement along microtubules and movement driven by polymerization or depolymerization of microtubules. [GOC:cjm, ISBN:0815316194]
label: MICROTUBULE BASED MOVEMENT *

description: Formation of a prolongation or process extending from a cell, e.g. a flagellum or axon. [GOC:jl, GOC:mah, PMID:18391171]
label: CELL PROJECTION ASSEMBLY *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of locomotion of a cell or organism. [GOC:ems]
label: REGULATION OF LOCOMOTION *

description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of intracellular signal transduction. [GOC:dph, GOC:signaling, GOC:tb, GOC:TermGenie]
label: NEGATIVE REGULATION OF INTRACELLULAR SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION *

description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the vasculature over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The vasculature is an interconnected tubular multi-tissue structure that contains fluid that is actively transported around the organism. [GOC:dph, UBERON:0002409]
label: VASCULATURE DEVELOPMENT *

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a peptide stimulus. [GOC:pr, GOC:TermGenie]
label: RESPONSE TO PEPTIDE *

description: The process in which the anatomical structures of blood vessels are generated and organized. The blood vessel is the vasculature carrying blood. [GOC:jid]
label: BLOOD VESSEL MORPHOGENESIS *

description: The series of molecular signals which triggers the apoptotic death of a cell. The pathway starts with reception of a signal, and ends when the execution phase of apoptosis is triggered. [GOC:mtg_apoptosis]
label: APOPTOTIC SIGNALING PATHWAY *

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating damage to the organism. [GOC:go_curators]
label: RESPONSE TO WOUNDING *

description: The series of events that restore integrity to a damaged tissue, following an injury. [GOC:bf, PMID:15269788]
label: WOUND HEALING *
